messages.author: e3baa8d88c523ecb
messages.subject: error with runMI
parts:
I want to run a multigroup model use runMI after using mice to multiply impute my data. However, I receive an error with runMI that I'm not sure how to correct.

##imputing data
imp<-mice(analytic2, m=20, maxit=35, pred=pred, printFLAG = TRUE)

##I then wanted to use runMI with the already imputed data.

##complete imputed dataset
mice.imp <- NULL
for(i in 1:20) mice.imp[[i]] <- complete(imp, action=i, inc=FALSE) 

##specify model
imp_ereg.m1 = "

ss5_dy_m ~ 1 + idtcsex_updated + idmethrace1_updated + ih1wholive1 + ces_t1_s + frs_t1_s + cen_ea3m_sen_m"

##fit a multigroup model
imp_ereg.fit1 <- runMI(imp_ereg.m1, data=mice.imp, fun="sem", meanstructure = TRUE, group="early_homeless")
summary(imp_ereg.fit1, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE, rsq=TRUE)

I receive the following error:
Error in slot(value, what) : 
  no slot of name "baselineList" for this object of class "lavaanList"

Any assistance is greatly appreciated.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: error with runMI
parts:
Error in slot(value, what) : 
  no slot of name "baselineList" for this object of class "lavaanList"

You just need to update to the latest development version of lavaan (and should check you have the latest semTools, too).

install.packages("lavaan", repos = "http://www.da.ugent.be", type = "source")
devtools::install_github("simsem/semTools/semTools")
